disclosure_review.summary: Plain affiliate disclosure is immediately before the first CTA and repeated in full in the footer.

claim_review.summary: Every product statement maps to current official documentation; unsupported pricing, discount, guarantee, ranking, security, and performance claims are absent.

claims_removed_or_softened: Removed all price, discount, free-trial, guarantee, and ranking language.
Replaced broad audio-quality claims with a recommendation to test a representative script.
Framed language and accent support as a voice-selection and listening check, not a guaranteed outcome.
